work_item: 订阅 HTTP 来源策略与文件名解析
changes: 删除 Debug 和 Release 的 Network Security Config 及域名白名单。
应用 Manifest 改为 android:usesCleartextTraffic=true，允许用户配置的公网和局域网 HTTP 订阅。
Content-Disposition 优先解码 RFC 5987 filename*，正确显示 UTF-8 中文文件名。

ui_import.entry: 配置 > 添加订阅链接

filename_header_regression.unit_test: SubscriptionClientTest#follows an http redirect before reading subscription bytes

security_boundary: HTTP response content is unencrypted in transit; users should use HTTPS when their source supports it.
limitations: The successful UI import used the preceding global base-config policy, which had the same all-host cleartext behavior; the final Manifest-only policy was separately verified by the POCO instrumentation test.
The already-imported row retains its previously stored suggested label; the corrected filename parser applies to subsequent imports. The user asked not to retry the now-expired link.
The local Release APK is unsigned; formal signing and publication use the tag workflow.
